entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [JIT] Reduce FP multiplication by -1 to plain negation #122272

Closed

  • [Wasm RyuJit] Add partial constant emitting support to codegenwasm.cpp #122161
    11.0.0
  • Abstract implementations of Type.IsVisible and Type.ContainsGenericParameters do not handle function pointers #122223

PullRequests

Created

  • [ilasm] Treat errors in -ERR mode as warnings #122270
    area-ILTools-coreclr
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 143.0.7499.40, windows: 143.0.7499.41 #122269
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono

Merged

  • [Wasm RyuJit] Add constant emitting support #122162
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Removing unnecessary conditional check #122271
    community-contribution, area-System.DateTime
  • Fix Type.IsVisible and Type.ContainsGenericParameters for function pointers #122224
    area-System.Reflection

Updated

  • Add fetchTags: false to all checkout steps in Azure Pipelines #122250
  • Optimize more bound checks around logical operators #122263
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, reduce-unsafe
  • Make the output of ThunkGenerator more diffable #122266
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [clr-interp] Fix issue around compliance with the rules about lazy initialized basic block stack details #122253
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • Fix TryEnsureSufficientExecutionStack with interpreter #122248
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Add side-effect free debugger display to `ValueStringBuilder`. #122265
    area-System.Runtime, community-contribution
  • JIT: Devirtualize generic virtual methods #122023
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add ArrayBuilder.AddRange and use it instead of List.ToArray pattern #122209
  • Bump actions/checkout from 4 to 6 #122003
    area-codeflow
  • Bump actions/upload-artifact from 4 to 5 #122004
    area-codeflow
  • Optimize TakeRangeFromEndIterator when start index is from end #122107
    area-System.Linq, community-contribution
  • Target net11.0 / .NET 11 #121853
    area-Infrastructure, linkable-framework
  • Fix IndexOutOfRangeException in ILVerify for invalid exception handler offsets #122056
    blocked, area-Tools-ILVerification
  • JIT: Constant fold SequenceEqual with the help of VN #121985
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Enable some HotReload tests for FieldRVA. #117952
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Fix lookup for current Thread in async signal handler #122048
    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [TestOnly] noop change #108158
    NO-MERGE, NO-REVIEW, area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122251
    Servicing-approved, area-codeflow
